level.menuName: User level: changes the templates and the help offered

A.name: Student
A.who: Secondary school and first years of a degree
A.what: Basic templates, the simple periodic table and chemistry explanations of every arrow.

B.name: Advanced student
B.who: End of a degree, master's and start of a PhD
B.what: The whole template library and online look-up; chemistry explanations if you want them.

C.name: Researcher
C.what: Everything, including the optional recognition server and, if you want them, the explanations of level A.

level.chooserTitle: Welcome to MecHand: what is your level?
level.chooserIntro: MecHand adapts the templates and the help to you. You can change it at any time with the **Level** menu in the bar.
level.basicTemplates: Level {level}: the {count} basic templates. Choose level B or C in the bar for the whole library.
